name: sproutsdata-js-monorepo
//: `npm run check` is the whole gate CI runs. The live suites (`e2e`, `e2e:examples`) and `smoke:live` need the local stack or a deployment, so they are not part of it.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:layers && npm run check:generated && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:package && npm run check:size && npm run smoke:dist && npm run smoke:edge && npm run check:links && npm run audit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk -w packages/langchain -w packages/ai-sdk && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/sdk -w packages/langchain -w packages/ai-sdk
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/sdk -w packages/langchain -w packages/ai-sdk
scripts.check:package: publint packages/sdk --strict && attw --pack packages/sdk && publint packages/langchain --strict && attw --pack packages/langchain && publint packages/ai-sdk --strict && attw --pack packages/ai-sdk
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e -w packages/sdk -w packages/langchain -w packages/ai-sdk
